desc: 一提开饮一提锁定，吸管口与直饮口兼得，细身可进车载杯托
leaf: 双层不锈钢自由口双饮保温水瓶（吸管口加直饮口、带锁扣提环）
name: 自由口双饮不锈钢保温瓶款

shots.intent: 在搜索结果里用完整侧身剪影一眼赢得点击，交付干净合规的平台主图。
把水瓶放进户外通勤的真实携带情境，让买家一眼代入自己的一天。
用悬停盖体与放大圆窗讲清一瓶双饮口的结构机制，回答到底怎么喝。
同机位并列锁定与提起两种状态，一秒讲清防漏锁扣与拎行两用法。
用瓶口与内壁的微距质感证明双层金属构造与做工，代替任何参数主张。
把同系列由低到高的档位并排陈列，帮买家在一次浏览里完成选款。
用立面比例线与一个日常参照物消除装不装得下的疑虑，数字全部留白待填。
用整块高饱和色面与提起的拎环定格收口，把加购动作留在一句标语的位置。

style.backgroundSystem: one solid flat field per screen on a cool marine system: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and elevation drawings, matte mist-blue #DCE9F0 for mechanism and macro screens, deep slate #24404D for the dual-state and size-ladder screens, raw concrete #C9C7C2 for the carry lifestyle screen, one saturated teal block #12808C for the closing screen; never a gradient, never a mixed or random environment
style.direction: cool marine minimalist insulated drinkware commerce
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line leader arrows and circular magnifier insets ringed in #24404D, flat matte, no glossy three-dimensional badges

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool marine minimalist insulated drinkware visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless pure white #FFFFFF, matte mist-blue #DCE9F0, deep slate #24404D, raw concrete #C9C7C2 and one saturated teal accent #12808C; one solid flat field per screen with no gradient and no mixed environment; bright even cool studio lighting with a front-left softbox key, fill card, soft contact shadows and a subtle rim on the dark screens, 5600K on the single daylight frame; modern geometric sans-serif kept for post compositing while every rendered frame carries only blank label plates, empty dimension bars and empty seal rings; thin single-weight line leader arrows and flat circular magnifier insets ringed in #24404D; stable upright slim cylinder, constant product scale and never-drifting lid colour blocking; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no gradient or textured backdrops, no invented spec numbers, units, hours or percentages.
noDrift: no invented spec numbers, units, hours or percentages
